linkedin_outreach_policy.content: Northwind RevOps LinkedIn Outreach Policy v3.1. (1) Connection requests must include a personalized note referencing a shared context, never a generic invite. (2) Existing 1st-degree connections receive a direct message; non-connections receive a connection request first, no message until accepted. (3) Outreach lists targeting >5 contacts require manager sign-off before sending. (4) CRM outreach status must only be updated after a message or invite is actually sent.

topic_segments_reference.content: Webinar audience segmentation guide. Tier A (highest fit): Director+ in RevOps / Revenue Operations at B2B SaaS. Tier B (strong fit): Director+ in Sales Ops or Marketing Ops at B2B SaaS. Tier C (low fit, exclude): individual contributors, non-SaaS industries (logistics, retail, freight), or below Director seniority. Recommended message angle for Tier A: forecasting & cross-team alignment. Tier B: CRM hygiene & ops scaling.
